title: Map landing omits the view-model and both themes
body:
## Summary
The landing context lists 4 files. The view-model and both themes, which the seam imports, are in no context.

## Description
context-map.json landing file_paths names LandingTV.tsx, fonts.ts, landingRows.ts and desk-landing.css. desk/src/landing has 16 files. 14 are absent from every context, including desk/src/landing/model.ts and desk/src/landing/themes/ (paper and blueprint). LandingTV.tsx imports both. docs/DESIGN-STUDY-DESK.md assigns the words to the view-model and the pixels to the themes, and names desk/src/design/desk-landing-blueprint.css, which is also unmapped. A sweep that stays inside the declared paths cannot see the caption or the look. Fixed means those paths are on the landing context. The map is the product's context inventory, so the edit is architecture and was not made this round.

## Flow
- Read the landing file_paths in context-map.json.
- List desk/src/landing. 14 of 16 files are not in any context.
- LandingTV.tsx imports landing/model and landing/themes.
- Leave the map unchanged.

## Expected impact
The next landing sweep would own the caption rules and both looks. Adding paths changes which files a later sweep may edit.

## Evaluation
Claim: other - the map names the files the landing is
Before: 14 of 16 files under desk/src/landing are in no context
After: those paths listed on landing; not applied
Method: probe - file list against the map; the map edit is architecture
Result: better
Gate: architecture
evidence: context-map.json landing file_paths (4); desk/src/landing has 16 files; LandingTV.tsx imports @/landing/model and @/landing/themes; docs/DESIGN-STUDY-DESK.md names model.ts, themes/, and desk-landing-blueprint.css
